items.claim: Tayson Gur relies too heavily on wrestling at times or becomes gunshy.
items.quote: either wasn't wrestling enough and was gunshy or wrestling entirely too much.

items.claim: Tayson Gur is never out of a fight and recently beat Aszmat McCoy as a tremendous underdog.
items.quote: he just showed the world that he is never out of a fight. He just beat Aszmat McCoy as a tremendous underdog

items.claim: Vicente is close to being washed up, but showed life in his last fight.
items.quote: Vicente is right on the cusp of being washed up, but he's not washed up left. We saw some life.

items.claim: Vicente will be the better fighter everywhere in the matchup against Tayson Gur.
items.quote: He will literally be the better fighter everywhere.

items.claim: Vicente will piece up Tayson Gur on the feet before Tayson can effectively wrestle.
items.quote: I think Vicente pieces up Tayson Gur on the feet. By the time Tson decides to wrestle, it's going to be too late.

items.claim: Vicente is too slick of a grappler and will snatch Tayson's neck if he shoots a sloppy takedown.
items.quote: Vicente is too slick of a grappler to just let Tayson shoot some sloppy takedown, not get his neck snatched.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias has fantastic grappling control, solid takedowns, and good athleticism on the ground.
items.quote: Raphael Tobias, a very good grappler. He's got solid takedowns. He's big. He's strong. He's fast. His athleticism really shines on the ground, though. He's got fantastic control.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias's striking is not very good and he is stiff.
items.quote: His striking is not very good and he is stiff

items.claim: Raphael Tobias is coming off a decision loss to Deion Nurgail in his UFC debut where he went two for eight in takedowns.
items.quote: He is coming off that decision loss to Deion Nurgail in his UFC debut where he went two for eight in takedown attempts.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is a long, rangy striker with defensively sound head movement and a nice jab.
items.quote: Lucas Fernando, a long long long striker... He is defensively sound as well. He's got good clean head movement, a really nice jab.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando lacks typical light heavyweight power but has great volume, speed, and finishing ability.
items.quote: He doesn't possess like the typical light heavyweight power that you would expect, but he's got great volume and he finds finishes. He's fast. He's athletic.

items.claim: Charles Johnson takes time to get going and typically gives up the first round.
items.quote: He takes a little while to get going. He will give up the first round

items.claim: Charles Johnson is a busy technical striker with good takedown defense, great hand speed, and high output.
items.quote: he's a busy technical striker. He's got good takedown defense, really nice hand speed. He's got nice output of almost five significant strikes per minute

items.claim: Charles Johnson has an 8-6 UFC record where all losses are to quality fighters.
items.quote: He is eight and six in the UFC, but all six of the losses are to quality fighters.
